handoff: Approve: claim release and story close push through the one push path (a person's push merged, never rebased); update outcome chosen by core updateOutcome; all ACs traced, tests green; 2 minor notes.

findings.title: Release no longer checks every branch before pushing any
findings.detail:
The removed fastForwardOf loop checked every branch before anything was pushed. Now branches push one at a time, so a slice branch push that fails (held markers, rejected) leaves the story branch already pushed. The record and the claim still wait, so nothing is lost, but the old 'nothing pushed or released' guarantee is now 'claim kept'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Acceptable as is; if all-or-nothing matters, run the held-marker check for every branch before the first push.

findings.title: Slice branches now force-push at release without the fast-forward guard
findings.detail:
At release, slice branches used to go out as plain pushes behind a fast-forward check ('a stale local branch never replaces the record'). They now force-push as at every boundary. releaseStory accepts an expired claim, so a stale checkout releasing an expired claim could overwrite a slice branch. The slice and Plan describe the change as no behaviour change except the merge of a person's push; the handoff names it under Easy to miss.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Leave it for the person to confirm; boundaries already force-push slice branches under the same claim.
